caseName: General Talking Pictures Corp. v. Western Electric Co.
caseNameFull: General Talking Pictures Corp. v. Western Electric Co.
attorneys: Messrs. Samuel. E. Darby, Jr. and Ephraim Berliner for petitioner., Messrs. Merrell E. Clark and Henry R. Ashton for respondents.

opinions.text: The petition for rehearing is granted upon the first two questions presented in the petition for writ of certiorari and the cause is assigned for argument on Monday, October 10, 1938. The motion to stay the mandate pending rehearing and determination by the Court is granted.
